info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Compliance By Param1-spec
info.description: The Regulatory Compliance Information API provides access to essential compliance data tailored to specific criteria identified by `param1`. This endpoint enables financial institutions and compliance officers to retrieve the latest regulatory compliance information necessary for adhering to legal standards. Typical consumers include risk management teams and compliance auditors who utilize this data to ensure robust compliance protocols. The API streamlines the process of accessing regulatory updates, facilitating informed decision-making and mitigating compliance risks.

get.description: This endpoint fetches the details of a specific regulatory compliance resource identified by its unique ID. It provides comprehensive information that is necessary for compliance tracking and reporting.
